subject: Quality Assurance & Testing
title: Network Condition Testing
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Network Condition Testing.

hook.text: On Wi-Fi, the app loads in 1 second. On a 2G connection in a rural area, it spins for 45 seconds and times out.

buildup.text: Mobile users experience 2G, 3G, 4G, 5G, Wi-Fi, and constant transitions between them.

discovery.text: Network throttling tools simulate slow, unstable, or absent connections during testing.

twist.text: The worst case isn't no connection—it's a connection that exists but barely works. Timeouts and retries fail.

climax.text: Testing on simulated 2G reveals the app needs progressive loading and lower timeout thresholds.

punchline.text: Test at the speed of your slowest user. Not your office Wi-Fi.

quiz.question: What is the hardest network condition to handle?
options: A connection that exists but barely works
